experiment.coordinate_convention: Right-handed Cartesian frame in metres. The planar tag trajectory is z=0. For the informative map, beacon b0=(0,0,h), b1=(d,0,h), b2 has positive y, and all four beacons share height h>0. Beacon IDs are zero-based.

motion.profile_node_units: fraction of duration, signed relative speed; variable profile normalized by peak forward excursion
motion.endpoint_rule: Position holds at path endpoints and outside [0,duration]; speed is zero while held
motion.path_parameterization: reference path arclength; narrow coverage uses dense polyline

acquisition_metadata.grouping_rule: assume every ping in epoch occurs at estimator_input.times_s[epoch]
acquisition_metadata.delivery_latency_rule: delivery_time_s=actual_time_s+latency; never used in batch fitting
acquisition_metadata.range_noise_pairing: fixed Gaussian draw indexed by cycle and beacon, independent of missingness and timing

solver.iterations_note: SciPy exposes evaluations, not iteration count

jacobian.scaling: Jacobian of normalized residuals with respect to theta / parameter_scale_m; all parameters in metres
jacobian.interpretation: Local measurement-only rank; full rank does not establish global uniqueness

augmented_jacobian.scaling: Jacobian of normalized residuals with respect to theta / parameter_scale_m; all parameters in metres
augmented_jacobian.interpretation: Augmented measurement and prior rank; prior is an assumption, not measurement information

diagnostics.solution_grouping: Raw canonical display trajectory and beacon RMS; sampled starts only
diagnostics.surveyed_map_source: Synthetic truth map explicitly supplied as surveyed knowledge

timing_approximation.definition: Actual ping truth position minus truth at common cycle start; independent of fitted interpolation and priors

truth_interpolation_floor.definition: Truth sampled at estimator knots and linearly interpolated; representation discrepancy, not a guaranteed optimization lower bound
truth_interpolation_floor.outside_domain_rule: Endpoint hold for floor evaluation only; estimator residual times always lie in knot domain

trajectory_model.domain_rule: Union of cycle, display, and assumed ping times; actual/delivery times excluded
trajectory_model.prior_definition: Interior knot minus time-weighted interpolation of neighbors, xy metres divided by prior_sigma_m; zero disables

diagnostics.ambiguity: Local measurement rank does not prove global uniqueness; d>0, beacon2 y>0 and h>0 select canonical branches. Priors are assumptions.
